DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの品物ですね。この袋ごと拾われたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ibibigay ninyo ang nahanap na bagay, tama? Kasama ba ang supot nang mapulot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 拾ったのはスマートフォンだけです。持ってくるために私の袋へ入れましたが、自分の充電ケーブルも中に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾ったのは電話だけで運搬袋と中のケーブルは自分の物と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Smartphone lang ang napulot ko. Inilagay ko sa sariling supot para madala, pero nasa loob din ang sarili kong charging cable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang napulot na telepono sa sariling supot at cable. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、拾った電話と、お客様のケーブルを分けて確認しましょう。ケーブルは、拾う前から袋にあったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Suriin natin nang hiwalay ang telepono at cable ninyo. Nasa supot na ba ang cable bago mapulot ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、朝から入れていました。黒い袋も私のものです。電話には触らず、自分の物だけ出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケーブルが発見前から私物だったと答え分けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, mula pa umaga. Akin din ang itim na supot. Maaari bang sariling gamit lang ang ilabas ko nang hindi ginagalaw ang telepono?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing personal na cable na ito bago ang pagkakita at itanong kung maaaring ihiwalay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで中を確認してからお示しします。この白いケーブルがお客様のものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Susuriin muna namin ang loob bago ipakita. Sa inyo ba ang puting cable na ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうです。根元に私のイニシャルを書いてあります。電話と一緒に落ちていたケーブルではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提示されたケーブルの目印を確認し電話と共に拾った物ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Nakasulat ang inisyal ko malapit sa puno nito. Hindi ito cable na kasamang nakahulog ng telepono.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang marka ng ipinakitang cable at sabihing hindi ito kasamang napulot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。ケーブルと袋はお返しします。電話を拾った場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Ibabalik ang cable at supot. Sabihin ang lugar at oras ng pagkakapulot ng telepono.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 公園の水飲み場の横で、二時十五分ごろです。拾ってから画面を開いたり、持ち主を調べたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得場所時刻と未操作を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa tabi ng inuman ng tubig sa parke, bandang alas-dos kinse. Mula nang mapulot, hindi ko binuksan ang screen o hinanap ang may-ari.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar oras ng pagkakapulot at hindi pa ito pinagana. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で電話をお預かりします。お名前と連絡先も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tatanggapin namin sa kondisyong iyon. Hihingin din ang pangalan at kontak ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入します。私の袋とケーブルは持ち帰り、拾った電話だけをこちらへお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入し私物を受け取り拾得電話のみ引き渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Isusulat ko. Iuuwi ko ang sariling supot at cable, at ang napulot na telepono lang ang ibibigay rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Isulat ang kontak, kunin ang personal na gamit at ibigay lamang ang napulot na telepono. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 電話をお預かりしました。お返しした私物も忘れずにお持ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Natanggap na ang telepono. Huwag kalimutan ang ibinalik na personal na gamit. Salamat sa pakikipagtulungan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転送を申し込んだ後のお荷物が心配とのことですね。追跡番号はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nag-aalala kayo sa paketeng kasunod ng kahilingan ng forwarding, tama? May tracking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、友人が旧住所へ送った荷物です。転送は申し込んだのに、友人から届いた画面には旧住所のまま載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転送申込み後も友人の荷物の画面が旧住所なので配達先を心配すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, ipinadala ng kaibigan sa lumang address. Humiling ako ng forwarding pero lumang address pa rin ang nasa screen na ipinadala niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mag-alala sa destinasyon dahil lumang address pa rin ang screen ng pakete matapos humiling ng forwarding. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その画面は、発送したときの送り先を示していますか。それとも現在の配達状況の画面でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ipinapakita ba niyan ang address noong ipinadala o kasalukuyang delivery status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた送り状の写真でした。追跡の画面だと思っていましたが、そこには配達の状態は書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見ていたのは現在追跡でなく発送時の送り状写真だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Larawan pala ng shipping label mula sa kaibigan. Akala ko tracking screen, pero walang nakasulat na delivery status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama na larawan ng label noong ipinadala, hindi kasalukuyang tracking, ang nakita. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送り状の住所だけでは、今どこへ向かっているかは分かりません。この番号で配送の担当へ照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi malalaman ang kasalukuyang patutunguhan sa address sa label lang. Itanong natin sa delivery staff gamit ang numerong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。この番号で今の状況を確認してください。転送の申込みの控えも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡番号で個別荷物の現在状況を確認してもらい転送申込み控えも示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisuyo. Suriin ang kasalukuyang lagay gamit ito. Ipapakita ko rin ang kopya ng forwarding request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang status ng partikular na pakete gamit tracking number at ipakita ang kopya ng request. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、個別のお荷物について確認します。旧住所では、今もどなたかが受け取れる状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo, susuriin ang paketeng ito. May makakatanggap pa ba sa lumang address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の同居人がいます。私の荷物が届いていないか聞いて、こちらでも照会してもらっていると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所の同居人に届いていないか尋ね照会中と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naroon ang dati kong kasama sa bahay. Itatanong ko kung dumating at sasabihing nagpapasuri rin ako rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tanungin ang kasama sa lumang bahay kung dumating at ipaalam ang kasalukuyang pagsusuri. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へは転送の申込みをしたことと、旧住所に同居人が残っていることを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Hiwalay naming sasabihin sa staff na humiling ng forwarding at may kasama pa sa lumang address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。友人にも新住所を改めて知らせます。今回の荷物については、確認できてから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人に新住所を知らせ今回の荷物は確認後に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakisuyo. Ipaalam ko rin muli ang bagong address sa kaibigan. Tungkol sa paketeng ito, kokontakin ko siya matapos matiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing ibibigay muli ang bagong address at saka ibabalita ang pakete matapos makumpirma. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの追跡番号で確認を進めます。送り状の写真と転送申込みの控えは、お手元に残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Susuriin gamit itong tracking number. Itabi ang larawan ng label at kopya ng forwarding request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報の変更ですね。記入していて分からない所はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pagbabago ng rehistradong detalye, tama? May hindi malinaw sa pagsulat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所が変わりました。この用紙には勤務先の欄もあって、引っ越したので全部書き直すのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更用紙の勤務先欄も書き直す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nagbago ang address ko. May employer field din dito at nag-aalinlangan kung kailangang isulat muli ang lahat dahil lumipat ako.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung kailangan ding ulitin ang employer field sa address-change form. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先も変わりましたか。変わった内容を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nagbago rin ba ang employer? Tatanungin ang mga pagbabago nang sunod-sunod.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事は同じ会社のままです。会社から遠くなりましたが、勤務先の住所自体は変わっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社は変わらず自宅が遠くなっただけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Parehong kumpanya pa rin. Mas malayo na ang bahay, pero hindi nagbago ang mismong address ng trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na pareho ang kumpanya at ang bahay lang ang lumayo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、ご自宅の住所変更として確認します。電話番号にも変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Suriin bilang pagbabago ng tirahan. Nagbago rin ba ang telepono?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号は同じです。ここを空欄にすると、電話もなくなったように見えるかもしれないので、記入方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話も同じで空欄の意味が不安なため書き方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pareho. Kung blanko, baka mukhang wala na akong telepono, kaya pakituro ang pagsulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pareho ang telepono at itanong ang sulat dahil nag-aalala sa kahulugan ng blanko. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更のない項目の書き方は、担当と一緒に確認できます。説明を聞いてからご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaari ninyong tiyakin sa staff ang pagsulat sa di-nagbagong bahagi. Makinig muna bago magsulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今の住所の書類はこちらです。会社と電話は変更なしと分かるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人住所資料を出し勤務先と電話を変更なしと明示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Ito ang dokumento ng kasalukuyang address. Gusto kong malinaw na hindi nagbago ang kumpanya at telepono.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang address document at gustong malinaw na employer at telepono ay di-nagbago. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容を担当へ伝えます。変更した住所は、建物名と部屋番号もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sasabihin sa staff. Suriin din ang building name at room number sa bagong address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号まで合っています。自宅住所だけが変わり、勤務先と電話は同じと伝えて、該当欄を確認して記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号を確認し変更項目を自宅住所だけにして記入相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tama pati room number. Sasabihin kong tirahan lang ang nagbago at pareho ang trabaho at telepono, saka titingnan ang angkop na field bago isulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang room number at magpasya ng pagkonsulta na tirahan lang ang nagbago. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類と用紙を担当にお出しください。変更する項目を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ibigay ang dokumento at form sa staff. Sama-samang susuriin ang babaguhing bahagi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲物について、何をご確認になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ano ang gusto ninyong tiyakin sa inumin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 甘くないものを探しています。この「砂糖不使用」は、甘くないという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 甘くない飲物を探し砂糖不使用が味も甘くない意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naghahanap ako ng hindi matamis. Ang “walang ginamit na asukal” ba ay ibig sabihing hindi matamis ang lasa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Maghanap ng hindi matamis at itanong kung no sugar ay hindi rin matamis na lasa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 砂糖を使っていないという表示です。この商品の原材料には、甘味料が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ibig sabihin hindi gumamit ng asukal. Nasa ingredients nito ang pampatamis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 甘い味は付いているんですね。砂糖の有無ではなく、甘くない味のものを買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 甘味料を知り砂糖有無より甘くない味を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: May matamis na lasa pa rin pala. Hindi matamis na lasa ang gusto ko, hindi lang kung may asukal o wala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Dahil may pampatamis, piliin ang hindi matamis na lasa kaysa asukal lang ang batayan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、こちらの無糖のお茶も候補になります。香りのお好みはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung gayon, pagpipilian din itong unsweetened tea. May gusto ba kayong amoy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 強い香りはあまり好きではありません。隣の果物の絵のあるお茶は、果汁入りか、香りだけかも分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 香りの好みを伝え果物の絵の飲物の果汁と香りの違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ako mahilig sa matapang na amoy. Ang katabing tsaa na may larawang prutas, may katas ba o amoy lang?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kagustuhan sa amoy at itanong ang juice laban sa aroma sa inuming may prutas sa larawan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この商品の原材料表示では、果汁ではなく香料があります。もう一方は、茶葉と水が記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Flavoring at hindi katas ang nasa ingredients. Ang isa ay dahon ng tsaa at tubig.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 絵だけでは中身が分かりませんね。果物の香りも今回は避けたいので、茶葉と水のほうを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原材料の違いを理解し果物香料も避け茶葉と水を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi malalaman sa larawan lang ang laman. Iiwas din ako sa amoy prutas ngayon, kaya titingnan ko ang dahon ng tsaa at tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unawain ang sangkap at piliing iwasan din ang fruit flavoring sa tsaa at tubig. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品です。容量も、ご希望の量に合うかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ito ang produkto. Tingnan din kung ang dami ay angkop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この量で大丈夫です。甘味料のある飲物ではなく、果物の香料もないこちらのお茶を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量を確認し甘味料と果物香料のない候補を買うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ayos itong dami. Pipiliin ko itong tsaa na walang fruit flavoring, hindi inuming may pampatamis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang dami at piliing bumili ng walang pampatamis at fruit flavoring. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらのお茶ですね。お会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itong tsaa, tama. Sa cashier po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お散歩からお戻りですか。何かお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Bumalik kayo mula sa paglalakad? May hinahanap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲物を買いたいんですが、財布を家族のバッグに入れたままでした。この自動販売機はスマホでも払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布を家族に預けたままのため販売機のスマホ決済可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong bumili ng inumin pero naiwan ang wallet sa bag ng kapamilya. Puwede bang smartphone payment dito sa vending machine?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Dahil nasa pamilya ang wallet, itanong kung may smartphone payment sa makina. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この機械の支払い表示には現金のみとあります。水飲み場でしたら、こちらにもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Cash only ang tanda sa makina. May inuman din dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現金だけですね。今は水飲み場を使いたいです。顔も洗っていい所か、飲むための蛇口だけか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金のみと理解し水飲み場の用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Cash lang pala. Gusto ko munang gamitin ang inuman. Puwede rin bang maghilamos o para sa pag-inom lang ang gripo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawain na cash lang at itanong ang gamit ng inuman. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは飲用の蛇口です。手洗い用の設備は、隣の建物側にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Para sa inumin ang gripong ito. Nasa tabi ng katabing gusali ang hugasan ng kamay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲用と手洗いを分けて使います。家族は遊具の近くなので、そこで合流して財布を受け取ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲用と手洗いを分け家族の所へ財布を受け取りに戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hiwalay kong gagamitin ang inuman at hugasan. Nasa tabi ng laruan ang pamilya, kaya doon ako babalik para kunin ang wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pag-inom at paghuhugas at bumalik sa pamilya para sa wallet. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 遊具へは、広場の外側の園路をお使いください。中央には催しの準備で荷物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Dumaan sa panlabas na daan ng plaza patungo sa laruan. May gamit sa gitna para sa paghahanda ng event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外側を通ります。先に家族へ連絡して、財布を持ってどこかへ探しに来てもらうより、私が戻ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迂回園路を使い家族を探しに来させず自分が移動すると連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa labas ako dadaan. Kokontakin ko muna ang pamilya na ako ang babalik, sa halip na papuntahin sila na dala ang wallet para hanapin ako kung saan-saan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Dumaan sa panlabas na ruta at ipaalam na ikaw ang lilipat, hindi sila ang maghahanap. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのほうが行き違いを避けられますね。水飲み場はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maiiwasan niyan ang hindi pagkakatagpo. Narito ang inuman.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水を飲んでから外側の園路で家族の所へ戻ります。家族には、遊具のそばで待っていてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に水を飲み外側を通って家族の待機場所へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iinom ako saka babalik sa pamilya sa panlabas na daan. Hihilingin kong maghintay sa tabi ng laruan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Uminom muna saka sa panlabas na daan bumalik sa paghihintayan ng pamilya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらの蛇口をご利用ください。園路では、作業中の荷物にもお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo, gamitin itong gripo. Mag-ingat din sa gamit na pinagtatrabahuhan sa daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームまでご案内が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kailangan ba ng direksiyon patungo sa platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 階段を使わない道を知りたいです。大きいスーツケースが二つあって、友人と一つずつ持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者と大荷物二つで階段を避ける経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong daan na walang hagdan. Dalawa ang malalaking maleta, tig-isa kami ng kaibigan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong ng rutang walang hagdan kasama ang kaibigan at dalawang malaking maleta. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この先のエレベーターをご利用いただけます。入口は狭いので、荷物の幅もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May elevator sa unahan. Makitid ang pasukan, kaya tingnan ang lapad ng gamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私だけ先に荷物を二つ運んで、友人に後から来てもらうつもりでした。でも、一人で二つ持つと動きにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で二つ運ぶ案は動きにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Balak kong dalhin muna ang dalawa at pasunurin ang kaibigan. Pero mahirap gumalaw kapag ako lang may dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na mahirap gumalaw kung isang tao ang may dalawang gamit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理にまとめず、お二人で一つずつ持って進まれてはいかがでしょう。今のご予定には時間の余裕がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag piliting pagsamahin; bakit hindi tig-isa kayong magkasabay? May sapat na oras?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発まで三十分あります。一つずつ持って二人で動きます。エレベーターに同時に入れなかったら、降りた所で待ち合わせてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 余裕時間を伝え一人一荷物に変え別々の利用時の合流場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: May tatlumpung minuto pa bago umalis. Tig-isa kami at magkasama. Kung hindi kami sabay makapasok sa elevator, puwedeng magtagpo sa labasan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang oras, gawing tig-isang gamit at itanong ang tagpuan kung magkahiwalay sasakay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、降りた所の通路を塞がない場所でお待ちください。別の階で降りないよう、行き先の階もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo, maghintay sa hindi haharang sa daanan sa labasan. Sasabihin din ang palapag para hindi magkaiba ang babaan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ホームの階ですね。友人は日本語の表示が読めないので、私が先にボタンの表示を見せて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が表示を読めないため自分が目的階を説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Palapag ng platform, tama. Hindi mabasa ng kaibigan ang Japanese, kaya ipapakita at ipapaliwanag ko muna ang label sa button.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Dahil hindi mabasa ng kaibigan ang tanda, sabihin mong ipapaliwanag mo ang palapag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内図と同じ番号の階です。お二人とも目的の階を確認してからお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Palapag na may kaparehong numero nitong mapa. Pareho munang tiyakin bago pumasok.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階の番号を友人に伝えました。荷物は一つずつ持ち、もし別々になったら、その階の広い所で合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目的階を共有し一荷物ずつ移動して必要なら同階で合流すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sinabi ko na ang numero sa kaibigan. Tig-isang gamit at kung mahiwalay, sa maluwag na lugar sa palapag na iyon magtatagpo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibahagi ang palapag, tig-isang gamit at magtagpo sa parehong palapag kung kailangan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: エレベーターはこの通路の先です。お二人の荷物に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nasa dulo ng daan ang elevator. Mag-ingat sa gamit ninyong dalawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。受付番号はお取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol sa paglipat papasok, tama? Kumuha na ng queue number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この番号を取りました。住所の手続きと健康保険について聞きたいんですが、同じ番号で待っていていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入と保険を一つの受付番号で待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kinuha ko ito. Gusto kong itanong ang address procedure at health insurance; maaari bang isang numero ang hintayin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maaaring isang numero sa paglipat at insurance. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この番号は住所担当の受付です。保険については、現在のご加入状況を担当へ伝えて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Para sa address desk ito. Sa insurance, sabihin ang kasalukuyang enrolment sa staff para kumonsulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の仕事を辞めてから引っ越しました。新しい会社では保険の説明を受けたところで、何が済んだかよく分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前職退職と新勤務先説明後の加入手続き状態が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lumipat matapos umalis sa dating trabaho. Katatapos lang ng paliwanag sa insurance sa bago, kaya hindi ko alam alin ang tapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi malinaw ang enrolment procedure matapos umalis at makinig sa bagong employer. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 加入状況が分かる会社の案内などはお持ちですか。ここでどの保険になるか決めず、保険担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: May impormasyon ng kumpanya na nagpapakita ng status? Sa insurance staff natin tiyakin, hindi dito magpapasya ng uri.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールがあります。個人の番号も書いてあるので、受付の前で読み上げるより、担当の方へ画面を見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社メールを担当へ直接提示し番号を公開で読み上げたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May email. May personal number din kaya mas gusto kong direktang ipakita ang screen kaysa basahin nang malakas sa harap ng reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Gustong direktang ipakita ang company email at ayaw basahin ang numero nang publiko. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ直接お見せください。先に住所の相談をし、その後、保険の窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Direktang ipakita sa staff. Address muna saka ituturo ang insurance desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 順番が分かりました。保険の番号をもう一枚先に取ると、住所の手続き中に呼ばれそうなので、後で案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口の順序を理解し保険番号の先取りを控えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ang order. Kung kumuha agad ng insurance number, baka tawagin habang inaayos ang address, kaya hihingi ng direksiyon pagkatapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unawain ang pagkakasunod at huwag muna kumuha ng insurance number. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その進め方で結構です。住所の受付が終わりましたら、こちらの係員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ayos iyon. Pagkatapos ng address reception, tawagin ang kawani rito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずこの番号で転入を相談します。終わってから保険の案内を受け、会社のメールを担当へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所の相談後に保険窓口の案内を受けメールを提示すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Una ang moving-in gamit ito. Pagkatapos ay direksiyon sa insurance at ipakita ang email sa staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya na address muna bago insurance directions at pagpakita ng email. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今の番号を持って住所担当の席でお待ちください。保険についてのご希望も伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hawakan ang numero at maghintay sa address desk. Ipaparating din ang nais sa insurance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の変更についてですね。予約票の内容を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pagbabago ng booking, tama? Ano ang nasa booking slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜日の午後に予約がありますが、勤務が変わって来られなくなりました。月曜日へ移せるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務変更で予約日を移したいと希望日時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May booking ako Biyernes ng hapon, pero nagbago ang trabaho at hindi makakapunta. Maaari bang ilipat sa Lunes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Dahil sa work change, sabihin ang nais na bagong araw at oras. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この票には「書類受取り」とあります。診察の予約とは別ですが、変更したいのはこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: “Pagkuha ng dokumento” ang sulat, hiwalay sa medical consultation. Ito ang babaguhin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでした。前の診察で頼んだ書類を受け取る日です。月曜日に診察を受け直すという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約は診察ではなく依頼書類の受取だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tama. Araw ng pagkuha ng dokumentong hiniling sa dating consultation, hindi ibig sabihing magpapatingin ulit Lunes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama na dokumentong hiniling ang kukunin, hindi pagpapatingin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類を受け取れる日時を担当へ確認します。提出先の期限はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sige. Titiyakin sa staff ang oras ng pagkuha. May deadline sa pagsumite?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 火曜日までに会社へ出します。月曜の受取りが難しい場合は、会社に期限の相談も必要になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の提出期限と受取延期なら会社相談が必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dapat sa kumpanya sa pinakahuling Martes. Kung mahirap Lunes, kailangang kausapin din ang kumpanya sa deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang deadline ng kumpanya at pangangailangang kumonsulta kung maantala ang pagkuha. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へその期限も伝えます。書類の完成連絡は、すでにお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sasabihin din ang deadline. Natanggap na ang abisong tapos na ang dokumento?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。予約票があるので完成していると思っていましたが、完成の確認も一緒にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完成連絡はなく完成と受取日時を両方確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi pa. Dahil may slip, akala ko tapos na. Pakitiyak din ang pagkakumpleto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Walang completion notice at ipatiyak ang readiness at pagkuha. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。完成状況と受取日時を確認して折り返します。今の金曜日の扱いも、その際にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Susuriin ang readiness at oras at tatawag pabalik; ipapaliwanag din ang kasalukuyang Biyernes noon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、書類の完成と月曜の受取りを確認してください。返事が来るまでは会社に月曜に受け取れると約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当回答まで受取日を会社へ約束せず照会を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakitiyak ang pagkakumpleto at Lunes na pagkuha. Hangga't walang sagot, hindi ako mangangako sa kumpanya na makukuha Lunes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hintayin ang sagot nang hindi nangangangako ng araw sa kumpanya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご依頼を承りました。担当から折り返す番号を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Natanggap ang kahilingan. Pakitiyak ang numerong tatawagan pabalik ng staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の紛失についてですね。ご自身の自転車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nawawalang bisikleta, tama? Sarili ninyo ba?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から借りています。今朝駐輪場に停めて、夕方戻ったらありませんでした。管理者には、移動していないと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた自転車が不在で管理者の移動なしという回答を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hiram sa kaibigan. Ipinarada kaninang umaga at wala pagbalik sa hapon. Sabi ng manager hindi nila inilipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang nawawalang hiniram na bisikleta at sagot na hindi inilipat ng manager. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 所有されているご友人へは連絡しましたか。登録情報などが分かると確認に役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakontak na ang kaibigang may-ari? Makatutulong ang registration details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ怖くて連絡できていません。でも自分のものではないので、友人に事情を話して登録の資料をもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人へ未連絡の不安を述べ所有者へ事情と登録資料を頼みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Natatakot pa kaya hindi pa. Pero hindi akin kaya gusto kong sabihin ang nangyari at humingi ng registration documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang takot dahil di-pa nakontak at nais ipaliwanag at humingi ng owner registration. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 借りていたことと最後に停めた状況を、ご自身から説明してください。友人への連絡を待つ間、車体の特徴も伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kayo ang magpaliwanag ng paghiram at huling pagpark. Habang hinihintay ang kaibigan, maitanong din ang itsura.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、かごの前に緑のひもがあります。借りるときに撮った写真は、私の携帯に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体の特徴と借りた際の写真があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kulay pilak at may berdeng tali sa harap ng basket. Nasa telepono pa ang larawang kinunan noong hiniram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ilarawan ang bisikleta at larawan noong paghiram. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見せてください。鍵はかけていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かけました。鍵は今も持っています。友人にはこの後連絡し、登録の名義と番号を教えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠と手元の鍵を示し友人から名義番号を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo, hawak ko pa ang susi. Kokontakin ko ang kaibigan pagkatapos para sa rehistradong pangalan at numero.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing naka-lock may susi at hihingi ng pangalan at numero sa kaibigan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 所有者の情報と、お客様が実際に見たことは分けて伺います。名義をお客様のお名前として記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay ang impormasyon ng may-ari at nakita ninyo. Huwag ilagay sariling pangalan bilang rehistradong may-ari.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。私は借りていた人として状況を説明します。友人の登録情報を確認できたら、改めてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分は借用者として見た状況を伝え所有者情報は確認後に追加すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige. Bilang humiram ipapaliwanag ang sitwasyon. Kapag natiyak ang registration ng kaibigan, ibibigay ko pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ikuwento ang nakita bilang nanghiram at idagdag ang owner info matapos kumpirmahin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、停めた時刻と場所から伺います。借りる際の写真もご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Magsimula sa oras at lugar ng pagpark. Ihanda rin ang larawan noong hiniram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保管しているお荷物のお受け取りですね。こちらは代引きの扱いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kukunin ang nakatagong pakete, tama? Cash on delivery ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知を持って来ましたが、私は何も注文していません。支払う前に、荷物の差出人を確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文の心当たりがない代引き荷物の差出人を支払前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dala ko ang notice pero wala akong order. Maaari bang tiyakin ang sender bago magbayad?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang sender ng di-kilalang COD parcel bago bayad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝票の差出人名と金額を一緒にご確認ください。ご家族が注文された可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan natin ang sender at halaga sa label. Posibleng kapamilya ang umorder?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母と暮らしているので、その可能性はあります。でも、この店名だけでは分かりません。母に電話して確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居の母が注文した可能性はあるが店名だけでは分からず本人に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kasama ko ang nanay kaya maaari. Pero pangalan ng shop lang hindi ko alam. Gusto kong tawagan siya para tiyakin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Posibleng nanay na kasama sa bahay ang umorder pero di-sapat ang shop name; nais tanungin siya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認してからお知らせください。お荷物は、まだこちらでお預かりしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipaalam kapag natiyak. Hawak pa namin ang pakete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話しましたが出ませんでした。母からの贈り物だと聞いていた別の荷物と、同じ物かも分かりません。今は支払わずに待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母が電話に出ず別の贈り物との同一性も不明なため未払いで待つ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tumawag pero walang sagot. Hindi rin alam kung kapareho ng ibang paketeng sinabi niyang regalo. Gusto kong maghintay nang hindi muna bayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Walang sagot si nanay at di-tiyak kung kapareho ng ibang regalo, kaya maghintay nang di-bayad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お受け取りの扱いを決める前に、担当へ確認しましょう。お母様には何をお聞きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Bago magpasya sa pagtanggap, itanong sa staff. Ano ang itatanong sa nanay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文した店名と、この金額の支払いが残っているかを聞きます。通知を見せますが、荷物を受け取ったとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店名と残る支払を母へ聞き通知だけを示して未受取と説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Shop na inorderan at kung may bayarin pang ganitong halaga. Ipapakita ang notice pero hindi sasabihing nakuha na ang pakete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tanungin ang shop at natitirang bayad, notice lang ipakita at sabihing di-pa nakuha. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できない場合の対応も担当がご案内します。ご希望を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag din kung di-matiyak. Sabihin ang nais ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母の返事を待ってから判断したいです。返事が遅くなるかもしれないので、保管期限と今の段階でできる手続きを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返事後に判断したいと伝え保管期限と現段階の手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Gusto kong magpasya matapos sumagot si nanay. Baka matagalan, kaya pakisabi ang holding deadline at maaaring proseso ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Nais magpasya matapos sagot at itanong ang deadline at proseso sa ngayon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まだ受け取りもお支払いもされていない状態として、担当へご相談を引き継ぎます。
